name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Never both drop the key while the door is still closed' matches the NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) hard rule; key_lost is defined as losing the key with the door not open, and the second part 'and open the door' is the condition side ('open the door') — the rule holds when the door never opens, so nothing further is required. Rule-only with empty FINAL_STATES is valid since the task states only restrictions.

texts: key_lost and door_open never both happen during the episode
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, door_open&key_lost) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, key_lost) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&key_lost, u3) -> -10
(u1, door_open, u3) -> -10
(u2, key_lost, u3) -> -10
